VideoContentPart.description: Video content part; served only through llama-server's ``input_video``.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether older videos remain past this page

VideoGalleryListResponse.title: VideoGalleryListResponse
VideoGalleryListResponse.description: A newest-first page of persisted videos, for infinite scroll.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Current phase: queued | denoise | export | completed | failed | null

total.title: Total
total.description: Total denoising steps for this run

video.description: Saved gallery record when phase is 'completed'

error.title: Error

VideoGenerateProgressResponse.title: VideoGenerateProgressResponse
VideoGenerateProgressResponse.description:
Live progress for an in-flight video generation, plus the terminal outcome
of the background job POST /video/generate started.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: What to avoid (if the model supports it)

model.title: Model
model.description: Video model to generate on. Only read when media auto-switch is on, where a downloaded model that is not the resident one is loaded first; omit to use whatever is loaded. The Video page never sends it.

width.title: Width
width.description: Frame width in pixels (a resolution preset of the loaded family)

height.title: Height
height.description: Frame height in pixels (a resolution preset of the loaded family)

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: Number of frames; must lie on the family's temporal lattice (k * frame_step + frame_offset)

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Number of denoising steps (default per model)

guidance_2.title: Guidance 2
guidance_2.description: Low-noise-stage guidance scale for a dual-expert MoE family (Wan2.2-A14B): the guidance the second transformer uses on the low-noise denoise steps. null lets the pipeline default it to the main guidance. Ignored by single-DiT families (their pipeline signature has no second guidance kwarg).

first_frame.title: First Frame
first_frame.description: Base64/data-URL image the clip starts from (image-to-video). It sets the geometry and is stretched onto the canvas. Omit for text-to-video. Rejected by a family that takes no keyframes.

last_frame.title: Last Frame
last_frame.description: Base64/data-URL image the clip ends on. Valid on its own (generate up TO a frame) or with first_frame (first-and-last-frame video), in which case it follows the first and is centre cover-cropped onto the canvas.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Subject / style / scene reference images (base64/data-URL), at most 9. The prompt refers to them as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ... in this order.

reference_videos.title: Reference Videos
reference_videos.description: Motion / camera reference videos, at most 3. The prompt refers to them as <Video 1>, <Video 2>, ... in this order.

reference_audios.title: Reference Audios
reference_audios.description: Standalone reference audio (base64/data-URL), at most 3, for voice or score. The prompt refers to them as <Audio 1>, <Audio 2>, ... in this order. Audio cannot be the only kind of reference a request carries.

flow_shift.title: Flow Shift
flow_shift.description: Sigma shift of the video schedule (MiniMax-H3 ships 12.0). Higher spends more of the schedule at high noise, which reads as more motion and less detail. null keeps the released value.

audio_flow_shift.title: Audio Flow Shift
audio_flow_shift.description: Sigma shift of the audio schedule (MiniMax-H3 ships 3.0). Needs the Diffusers engine: stable-diffusion.cpp derives the audio schedule against a hardcoded 3.0, so it has no flag to map this onto. null keeps the released value.

reference_image_size.title: Reference Image Size
reference_image_size.description: How reference images are sized: match (default) scales each down to the generation's pixel area; max uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, several times slower. max needs the Diffusers engine -- stable-diffusion.cpp rescales every reference to the generation area regardless.

VideoGenerateRequest.title: VideoGenerateRequest
VideoGenerateRequest.description: Request to generate one clip from the loaded video model.

status.title: Status
status.description: Discriminator: the generation job was started

video.description: Always null (kept for response-shape compatibility); the saved record is delivered by generate-progress on completion

VideoGenerateResponse.title: VideoGenerateResponse
VideoGenerateResponse.description:
Acknowledgement that a generation was accepted and started.

Generation runs as a background job (a clip takes minutes, and secure mode's
tunnel caps the origin response window near 100 seconds, so the POST cannot
span it). The saved gallery record arrives via GET /video/generate-progress
when its phase reaches "completed".

frame_offset.title: Frame Offset
frame_offset.description: Temporal lattice offset: valid counts are k * frame_step + frame_offset

duration_presets.title: Duration Presets
duration_presets.description: Clip durations in seconds the UI offers

resolution_multiple.title: Resolution Multiple
resolution_multiple.description: Width/height must be divisible by this

resolution_presets.title: Resolution Presets
resolution_presets.description: (width, height) presets the UI offers, default first

canvas_short_edge.title: Canvas Short Edge
canvas_short_edge.description: Short edge a source-derived canvas aims for, or null when the family has no keyframe canvas rule. With canvas_max_pixels and resolution_multiple this is the whole rule: short edge, then cap the area, then round both axes.

canvas_max_pixels.title: Canvas Max Pixels
canvas_max_pixels.description: Area budget of a source-derived canvas, or null (see canvas_short_edge)

flow_shift.title: Flow Shift
flow_shift.description: Released video-schedule sigma shift, or null when the family does not expose the control

audio_flow_shift.title: Audio Flow Shift
audio_flow_shift.description: Released audio-schedule sigma shift, or null (see flow_shift)

supports_audio_flow_shift.title: Supports Audio Flow Shift
supports_audio_flow_shift.description: Whether the ACTIVE engine can honour audio_flow_shift; false on stable-diffusion.cpp, which pins the audio schedule at its released value

VideoGenerationDefaults.title: VideoGenerationDefaults
VideoGenerationDefaults.description: Per-family generation defaults + shape constraints for the loaded video model.

VideoGenerationPresetParams.title: VideoGenerationPresetParams
VideoGenerationPresetParams.description: Bounds track VideoGenerateRequest, as the image params track theirs.

downloaded_bytes.title: Downloaded Bytes

memory_mode.title: Memory Mode
memory_mode.description: Memory policy: auto (measured), fast (resident), balanced (stream the transformer, near-resident speed, moderate VRAM cut), low_vram (offload every component, lowest VRAM, slower).

speed_mode.title: Speed Mode
speed_mode.description: Opt-in speed optims (default off -> bit-identical output): eager (channels_last + cudnn + attention + fused norm patches, NO torch.compile), default (also regional torch.compile where eligible), max (also TF32 + fused QKV). GGUF video loads default to the near-lossless compile profile.

attention_backend.title: Attention Backend
attention_backend.description: Attention kernel via the diffusers dispatcher. auto picks the best exact backend for the device (cuDNN fused attention on NVIDIA when a speed profile is active; native SDPA elsewhere and when speed=off). native (alias sdpa) forces default SDPA; cudnn/flash/flash3/flash4 are exact (kernel/arch-gated); sage is INT8 attention; xformers/aiter are memory-efficient (NVIDIA) / AMD ROCm. An unavailable kernel falls back to the default.

transformer_cache.title: Transformer Cache
transformer_cache.description: Opt-in step caching (off by default). fbcache = First-Block-Cache: reuse the transformer tail across denoise steps when the first block's residual barely changes. Engages on many-step schedules only; incompatible models run uncached.

transformer_cache_threshold.title: Transformer Cache Threshold
transformer_cache_threshold.description: FBCache residual threshold (higher = skips more steps = faster, lower quality). null auto-picks the family default.

transformer_quant.title: Transformer Quant
transformer_quant.description: Quantise the dense DiT(s) on a full-pipeline load. On a diffusers pipeline load the dense bf16 transformer(s) are torchao-quantised in place onto the low-precision tensor cores (int8 first on every tier, then fp8 on sm_89+), which is faster than running dense bf16. For a dual-expert MoE family (Wan2.2-A14B) BOTH experts are quantised with the same scheme. null/none/off keeps the DiT(s) at their loaded precision; an explicit scheme forces it. Needs CUDA + bf16; ignored on gguf/single_file loads (they carry their own precision). Mirrors the image backend's transformer_quant field.

text_encoder_quant.title: Text Encoder Quant
text_encoder_quant.description: Quantise the dense companion text encoder (Gemma3 / UMT5 / Qwen2.5-VL), which loads bf16 from the base repo regardless of how the DiT was sourced and is often the largest resident component. fp8 = diffusers layerwise casting (memory only, cc >= 8.9); fp8_dynamic = torchao per-row fp8 COMPUTE on the tensor cores (cc >= 8.9); int8 = torchao int8 COMPUTE with per-family keep-bf16 selection (cc >= 8.0; falls back to fp8 for a family without a measured schedule); nvfp4 = torchao 4-bit weight-only (Blackwell sm_100+). null/auto leaves the choice to the backend, which keeps the encoder dense on every family except MiniMax-H3, where it takes the hosted quantized conditioner; none/off always keeps the released bf16 encoder, which on MiniMax-H3 is the only way to ask for it. Mirrors the image backend's field.

h3_task.title: H3 Task
h3_task.description: Which MiniMax-H3 denoiser partition to bring up: fl2va (text-to-video and first/last-frame video, the default) or ref2va (omni-reference video). They are separate ~62 GB partitions, so a load serves one of them. Ignored for a GGUF pick, whose filename already names the partition; rejected if it contradicts that filename.

gpu_ids.title: Gpu Ids
gpu_ids.description: CUDA / ROCm physical indices this load may use, or null for automatic. Neither engine shards a video checkpoint, so a selection of several cards resolves to the one with the most free VRAM. Refused with a 400 when an index does not exist here; ignored on XPU / MPS / CPU, which have no applicator for a physical index. Mirrors the image backend's field.
